entry.title: New: Bill 205 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10, DIVISION 5, SECTION 24-279, SCHEDULE 27, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO PARKING ON PAVEMENT PROHIBITED AT ALL TIMES AND CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10, DIVISION 5, SECTION 24-280, SCHEDULE 28 OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO NO PARKING AT ANYTIME

Establishes parking restrictions for certain portions of Opelo Road in Kohala.

Latest action: Council: Bill 205 passes second & final reading - 11/8/2024
